questions.subject: Music
questions.prompt: In C–Am–F–G, what role does the G chord play in the progression?
questions.answer: The dominant, pulling back to C
questions.why: G is the 'V' chord, the dominant — it creates tension that naturally resolves back to C, the tonic.
options: The dominant, pulling back to C
The subdominant, built on the fourth degree

questions.prompt: Order these ranks in Japan's feudal hierarchy, from most power to least
questions.why: The shogun held supreme military power, daimyo controlled regions under him, samurai served daimyo, and peasants farmed the land at the bottom.
